excerpt.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
excerpt.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

从[From.solar_system.GetName]星系传来一束紧急优先呼叫；我们的屏幕被追兵占满了。

“舞跳得真不错嘛，但你们很快就要死在我们前面，那就跳不了了。[GetHeirsBargain]
texts.en:
A priority hail pings us in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system; our pursuers fill the viewscreen.

"You danced well, for a time. Pity it ends with you dead in our sights. [GetHeirsBargain]

texts.zh:
敌人的声音在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系中响亮地回荡着，追兵已经出现在了显示屏上。

“追逐到此为止了，流亡者。我们已经标记锁定了你的反应堆。[GetHeirsBargain]
texts.en:
Our hostile target tones chime loudly in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system as our perusers appear on our displays.

"The chase ends here, exile. We have a target lock on your reactor. [GetHeirsBargain]

texts.zh:
掠夺者的字符侵入了[capital_scope.GetName]的主显示屏，与此同时，追猎我们的舰队从超空间航道涌出。

“你作为一名流亡者，飞得倒是挺利索的。但你被困在我们的斩杀航线里了。[GetHeirsBargain]
texts.en:
Marauder glyphs infiltrate the main display of [capital_scope.GetName], as our hunter's fleet leaves their hyperlane.

"You fly sharp for an exile. But you're boxed in our kill-lanes. [GetHeirsBargain]

We will pay your toll.
Our [Owner.GetRulerTitle] is not afraid of you!

texts.zh: “住手！你的驾驶机动水平已经证明了你确实是个真正的掠夺者，被放逐又如何。今天我们不会为所谓的荣誉而付出更多代价。开个价，饶我们一命吧。”[Root.GetSpeciesName]在[From.GetName]上喊道，身边是毁坏的舰桥。
texts.en: "Stand down! Your piloting makes you a true Marauder, exile be damned. We will not trade more plating for pride today. Name the fee to spare us." The [Root.GetSpeciesName] on the [From.GetName] hails from a ruptured bridge.

texts.zh:
被我们击败的敌方舰队很快就发出了投降信号。

“也打够了，这次是你们占了上风。现在，你要我们交出什么，好让我们能清洗船上的这个小污点，继续前进。”
texts.en:
The hostile fleet we defeated quickly signaled their surrender.

"That's enough of that. You've the better of us this time. Now, what must we hand over so we can polish this little blemish off the hull and move on."

texts.zh:
“我们投降了！求求你！你还记得我们吗？我们一直都忠于你的部族。所谓的流放根本就是个骗局。告诉我们怎样才能效力！”

[From.GetName]上的舰长似乎已经濒临崩溃，他们的[Root.Species.GetMouthName]颤抖着。
texts.en:
"We surrender! Please! You remember us; we were always loyal to your clan. This exile is a sham. Tell us how we can serve!"

The Captain aboard the [From.GetName] seems close to the edge, their [Root.Species.GetMouthName] trembling.

label.en: Just leave our sight.
We will not accept surrender.
We will not accept surrender.

label.zh: 这就是真正的虚空。在这里，没有投降。
label.en: This is the truth of the void. Out here, there is no surrender.

label.zh: 如果你们真的忠诚，就应该和我们一起离开。
label.en: If you were truly loyal you would have left with us.

label.zh: 要么拿货要么拿命，你自己选。
label.en: Your cargo or your lives. The choice is yours.

label.zh: 就把这个当作是面试吧。最后谁能活下来谁就可以加入我们。
label.en: Consider this your interview. Last one breathing gets to join up.
We want your crew.

label.zh: 我会让你们一个人瘸着回去，让他们知道将要面对什么。
label.en: We will send one of you limping. The next will know what's coming.

tooltips.zh: 下一次猎杀会推迟几年再来。
tooltips.en: The next hunters will be delayed by a few years.

label.zh: 要么把你们舰队司令交出来，要么我们就自己从残骸里把他拖出来。
label.en: Give up your Admiral. Or we shall scrape them out of the wreckage.

summary.text:
# 熟悉的猎兵 / Familiar Hunters

- 分类 Category：C1 起源 / C1 Origins · DLC: Nomads

## 如何开始 How it starts

仅限可汗后裔起源：只要尚未在决斗中称汗，nomads.500 每200–300天派出一批赏金猎兵（nomads.505），玩家收到“熟悉的猎兵”506（L3701-4160）。

Heirs of the Khan only: until the heir wins the Khan duel, nomads.500 sends a band of bounty hunters every 200-300 days (nomads.505), and the player gets Familiar Hunters 506 (L3701-4160).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

之后两种收场：被猎兵截住时，若此前已约定“遇敌谈判”，他们发来“讨价还价”570（付过路费、威胁、或买断合约）；若猎兵舰队被打瘫，则发来“聆听请求”555（放走、拒绝投降，或按此前约定的条件勒索货物、船员、海军上将等）。

Two ways it ends: if they catch us and a negotiation had been agreed, they send A Bargain 570 (pay the toll, defy them, or buy out their contract); if their fleet is disabled they send A Plea 555 (let them go, refuse surrender, or extort cargo, crew, an admiral and so on depending on earlier choices).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

每批猎兵只会走其中一条；猎兵会周期性再来，直到称汗。

Each band takes only one path; bands keep coming until the heir becomes Khan.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

两份对话的正文与可选条件取决于此前谈判留下的标记（heirs_bargain_* / heirs_option_*）。

The texts and options of both dialogues depend on flags left by earlier bargains (heirs_bargain_* / heirs_option_*).
